note: Rejudged over the reworded note. RFC 7684 Section 2.1: "the LSA flooding scope MUST satisfy the application-specific requirements for all the prefixes included in a single OSPFv2 Extended Prefix Opaque LSA." TestExtPrefixScopeSelection pins extPrefixScope (ext.go) literally: types 1, 3 and 7 map to area, type 5 to AS. The per-LSA pair drives the real extPrefixOnOriginate over stub, Type-3 and Type-5 self LSAs, checks every decoded TLV against its LSA's scope with literal counts (3 area, 2 AS), and proves the prefix needing two scopes never shares an LSA. Note verified: selfPrefixAdverts reads only Router, Summary-Network and AS-External self LSAs, so no route type 7 Extended Prefix TLV is originated, although Ze originates Type-7 LSAs (lsdb/nssa.go OriginateNSSA). RFC 7684 puts no obligation on originating an Extended Prefix TLV for NSSA prefixes: Section 2 leaves the LSA under the control of the advertising router.
